svg.title: Retro-Futurism 1920s / Tomorrowland — Aesthetics of the Future That Never Was
svg.desc: Art Deco illustration showing how the Jazz Age imagined the year 2000: copper spaceships, vacuum tube computers, monocle-wearing astronauts, and geometric Metropolis-inspired architecture.
svg.text: AESTHETICS OF THE FUTURE THAT NEVER WAS
How the Jazz Age imagined the Year 2000
"Metropolis (1927) — The future is built of steel and light"
✦ ANNO DOMINI MMXXVI ✦ IN THE SPIRIT OF FRITZ LANG ✦
